factions.name: Helix Consortium
factions.public_message: Continuity, prioritisation, protected zones, managed recovery.
factions.private_strategy: Use emergency authority and control of logistics to reserve viable systems for controllable or profitable populations.
factions.narrative_function: Primary institutional antagonist. Its power comes from infrastructure and policy, not magical omniscience.
writing_rules: Do not portray Helix as all-knowing.
Show internal procedure and material constraints.
Defeating one commander must not automatically end Helix's influence.

factions.name: Earth Systems Restoration Network
factions.public_message: Stabilise conditions long enough for communities to recover.
factions.narrative_function: Shows that Aster is collaborative work, not the miracle of one genius.
factions.status: Dispersed; members are missing, dead, trapped, or communicating through incomplete records.

factions.name: Shelter Residents
factions.narrative_function: Makes civilian aid concrete. Includes organisers, families, maintenance workers, and people who disagree about trust and risk.
writing_rules: Never portray as a faceless crowd.
Give optional-rescue characters agency and practical knowledge.

factions.name: Port Evacuees and Workers
factions.type: displaced civilians, dock workers, smugglers, and evacuation staff
factions.narrative_function: Shows selective evacuation and creates optional aid decisions.
writing_rules: They do not exist merely to wait for Marcus.
Their actions can reveal routes, protect others, or preserve evidence.
